description: This session's task list: sections of steps the agent tracks as it works, seeded from an approved plan.

settings.label: Require A Task

options.label: All tool calls — every request with tool work goes in the task list
Changes only — tools that change something

settings.hint: Before a tool call runs, its user request must be cited on a section or step of the session task list, with a step in progress (the app opens a section itself when none is open). All tool calls (default): every tool except the core basics (task list, skills, time, mode); a request set aside as needing no tools cannot get tool calls. Changes only: just tools that change something. Off: the agent is only reminded.
